title: Takumi TT Level 2.1 DC / Takumi Aka MC — 1 kHz Reference Check

harmonic_reliability.quality_note: The right channel's overall distortion changed most during recording. Repeat before changing the cartridge setup.

capture_note.quality_note: Low raw capture level. Speed remains usable; crosstalk and harmonic results may be noise-limited.

interpretation.summary: The Takumi TT Level 2.1 DC averaged 33.33 RPM under stylus load with 0.030% DIN-shaped wow and flutter RMS. The measurer observed excellent vibration rejection and moderate tracking ability. The crosstalk capture followed azimuth adjustment, with cartridge alignment still imperfect in the measurer’s assessment. The measurer flagged a possible sample defect as a contributor to the crosstalk result. Low capture level may have limited the crosstalk and harmonic readings.
interpretation.recommendation: The report advises repeating the capture before changing the cartridge setup because the right channel’s overall distortion varied most during recording.

session_observations.source: Measurer account supplied with publication request

cartridge_condition.observation: The measurer identified a potential defect in this particular cartridge sample as one possible contributor to the crosstalk result.

provenance.data_entry_method: Numerical results were transcribed from the original PDF report and checked against its rendered page. Reported differences preserve source precision. The vibration rejection, tracking and azimuth observations and the possible influence of cartridge sample condition come from the measurer’s session account.
provenance.raw_audio_note: No raw test-record audio is included.
provenance.setup_metadata_source: The report identifies the Takumi Aka MC and ART and labels the capture input USB Audio CODEC.
known_limitations: The report flags a low raw capture level. Speed remains usable, while crosstalk and harmonic results may be noise-limited.

The tonearm model, ART preamp model, capture-device model, tracking force, anti-skate, alignment geometry, loading, test record and track, capture settings, repeat count and software versions were not recorded.
Vibration rejection and tracking ability were supplied as qualitative session observations. The condition of the particular cartridge sample was not confirmed.
provenance.fingerprint_channel_assignment: Channel assignments follow the supplied filenames. Both channels show eight rotations. The angular reference between captures is unspecified.
provenance.photo_treatment: The archived source is a full-resolution 5712 × 4284 JPEG from the supplied Takumi/IMG_4517.HEIC with embedded metadata stripped. The editorial version uses the built-in ImageGen edit to straighten the composition, reduce background clutter and brighten the scene.
